articles.title: From 'dirt poor' to philanthropic superstar - the life of Dolly Parton
articles.description: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80, the singer's team announced on social media.

articles.title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
articles.description: A household using a typical amount of gas and electricity will pay £60 a year more, regulator Ofgem says.

articles.title: Cosmic radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
articles.description: Former Air France stewardess Sophie Lainault has had her cancer recognised as an occupational disease.

articles.title: Why Pride is facing a backlash - from inside and outside the LGBT community
articles.description: Big companies used to go out of their way to support Pride. Now, there's a nervousness in the air, Darren Milby writes
